name: FrenchModelVariant475_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant475_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (ribbons, timed quads and four-quad sheets travel from eight points around a model part to a target 450 units in front of or behind the slot while the light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, takes eight model parts, seeds the eight start and end points and packs six texture images, otherwise it runs one frame through the ribbon, quad and sheet helpers and returns 4 in phases 3 to 5, 1 once in phase 6, 2 in phase 8 after the light fade and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the US header-458 images build the French header-475 source with the palette column 512 instead of 640; the PAL images bind its data 0x64 higher. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
